description: Trust-weighted consensus over N agent answers — the fix for the ~17x multi-agent compounding-error trap. Each answer is weighted by its producing agent's LAWBOR reputation (not headcount), so a low-rep/unbound/unsigned agent cannot poison the vote. Returns the quorum answer + confidence + per-agent weights. Optional per-submission signature gates inclusion.

signature.description: Optional: agent signs the answer (EIP-191 for 0x, Ed25519 for did:key). Invalid sig excludes the submission.

name: lawbor_quorum
